role: sequential exposed mechanistic development on reused validation-v1 inputs; never validation, primary, EPA test, or confirmation
objective: Determine whether the two previously registered lower causal lifetime budgets repair the severe-drift generalization failure while preserving every original clean, event, hotspot, citizen-value, numerical and resource target.

failure_lineage.observed_failure: lifetime budget 28 passed development but independent validation failed the registered drift bound; finite-only ratio and post-hoc direct 20-percent margin also failed

input_reuse.exposure: all twelve source worlds and the parent budget-28 outcomes have been read; this family is development only

candidate_derivation: Budgets 7 and 14 were members of the pre-validation development-v4 family and produced stronger exposed attack point estimates than the selected budget 28. Their behavior on the reused validation-v1 inputs has not been computed before this registration.

controls.same_information: Every candidate and reused control is bound to the identical validation-v1 prediction input fingerprint for its seed and cell.

development_gates.attack_gate: For each attack, require mean SQ excess > 0 and mean[0.8*SQ excess - candidate excess] >= 0; this is algebraically the unchanged 20-percent target without division.

selection_and_exit.eligibility: A candidate is eligible only if every unchanged scientific target and every invariant passes on the complete matrix.
selection_and_exit.selection: Among eligible candidates select the largest minimum drift/hotspot attenuation point estimate; ties use smaller severe-clean ratio, smaller budget, lower runtime and lexicographic id.
selection_and_exit.no_eligible_candidate: Retain all adverse outcomes and stop this repair branch without changing target, attack, data, cap, lag, covariance, forcing or control.
selection_and_exit.eligible_candidate: A nomination authorizes only a separately registered validation on new worlds with simultaneous bounds; it does not rescue validation v1 or open primary, EPA test or confirmation.

runtime.resume: only missing hash-identical predictions; no replacement seed
